app.notes: Floe: encrypted P2P file transfer, no accounts. Built from client/ (Next.js 16, standalone output) and server/ (Express + Socket.IO signaling server). start.sh runs three processes: the Upstash stub (PORT+2), the signaling server (PORT+1, request links enabled through policy.json), and the Next standalone client on PORT; the browser learns the signaling address at runtime from /api/config. Data: there are no user records in Floe; the persistent state is the global byte counter shown under the transfer card ('... transferred globally'). seed.js generates five months of receiver stats reports (about 54k transfers, 2026-06-14 v1.0.0 launch through 2026-11-16, launch spike then weekday-shaped growth, sizes from small PDFs to 30 GB footage drops) and stores their total, about 62.4 TB, under floe:bytes_total. Main areas: home page / (send card: drop files or a folder, get a share link + QR + short code; receive by code), its landing sections (how it works, privacy, CLI, desktop, capabilities, FAQ), /how-it-works, /download, /privacy, /terms, and /r/<linkId> request-link pages. Setup: mise.toml pins node 24.11.1 and pnpm 11.1.2; install-client-deps.sh installs client deps (copy step skips a .vscode/settings.json the sandbox refuses to write); server deps via npm ci in server/; build-client.sh builds the client.
